name: Mitya
title: Rules Set at Naught
description: An exceptionally ingenious energy specialist and a master of the fine art of "schedule-dodging."

normal.1: Performs a maximum of 3 attacks that deal <electro>Electro DMG</electro>.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> to the area in front after a short casting time.
charged.2: Mitya will instead perform the special Charged Attack Gradient Detonation, which consumes no Stamina, if a Detection Core: Overload created by Mitya himself is currently on the field and he has at least 1 Gradient Beacon: Deals 1 instance of AoE Electro DMG to the area in front and continuously consumes Gradient Beacons while held. Each Gradient Beacon consumed deals 1 instance of AoE Electro DMG to the area in front that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> upon impact.

description.0: Conducts a theoretically relatively safe experiment at a theoretically relatively safe yield, dealing AoE Electro DMG and creating a Detection Core in different ways depending on whether the Skill is tapped or held.
description.2: Tapping the Elemental Skill Principle: Variable Detection again within 6s after using it changes the Detection Core's state. The Detection Core's state can be changed in this way every 1.5s.

skillParams.3: Steady State Core Gradient Beacon Consumption DMG

description.0: Let the elements burst forth like inspiration itself! Deals AoE Electro DMG and creates 3 Gradient Beacons.
The Detection Core created by the Elemental Skill Principle: Variable Detection is enhanced. Depending on the state of the Detection Core created:
1: Steady State: All nearby party members gain 30 Elemental Mastery for each Gradient Beacon Mitya has;
Overloaded: After nearby party members trigger Stellar-Conduct reactions, instead obtain 1 Gradient Beacon every 1.5s for 6s.

description.0: The duration of Gradient Beacons is increased to 10s. Additionally, Mitya's CRIT Rate increases by 5% for 15s after creating a Gradient Beacon. This effect can stack up to 4 times.

When party members trigger Superconduct, it will be changed to Stellar-Conduct. Stellar-Conduct reactions will no longer create Starlight Prisms, and will instead create 1 Gradient Beacon nearby every 1.5s for 3s. These Beacons can be carried by Mitya and transform the area around them into an even larger Polestar Field. Triggering another Stellar-Conduct reaction will refresh the duration of the aforementioned effects.
description.1: Additionally, the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG dealt by all nearby party members will be increased based on Mitya's Elemental Mastery: Every point of Elemental Mastery he has increases Base Stellar-Conduct DMG by 0.028%. The maximum Base DMG increase that can be gained this way is 14%. While within a Polestar Field, Mitya will also enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state.

description.0: When destructible rocks are nearby, Detection Core: Steady State can quickly clear them.
description.1: Additionally, when Mitya is in the party, creating Prime Ice Construct: Basic Heat Source does not consume Kresnik Energy.

constellation1.name: The Observer Seeking What Is Missing

description.0: The maximum number of Gradient Beacons Mitya can carry is increased to 5. Using the Elemental Skill Principle: Variable Detection additionally creates 1 Gradient Beacon.
description.1: While the Detection Core is present, your own active character's CRIT DMG is increased by 40%.
description.2: Additionally, Mitya regenerates 10 Elemental Energy when a Gradient Beacon is created. This effect can be triggered once every 8s.

constellation2.name: The Matter That Slumbers Beyond Inertness

description.0: While the Detection Core is present, all opponents within the Polestar Field have their Cryo RES and Electro RES decreased by 20%.
description.1: Additionally, if the Detection Core created is:
2: Steady State: All nearby party members gain 123 Elemental Mastery;
Overloaded: Your own active character gains 234 Elemental Mastery.

constellation3.name: The Knotted String of Invariant Topology

description.0: Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill Principle: Variable Detection by 3.

Detection Cores created by Mitya himself deals 1 instance of AoE Electro DMG equal to 300% of Mitya's Elemental Mastery to nearby opponents for every 5 Gradient Beacons consumed while it is on the field. This DMG is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.

constellation5.name: The Periodic Law That Orders All

description.0: Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Chain Reaction by 3.

constellation6.name: Elemental Transition at the Gate of Reason

description.0: Detection Core is enhanced. If the Detection Core:
description.1: · Is in the Steady State: Detection Core deals 115% of its original DMG.
2: Is Overloaded: There is a 34% chance to create 1 new Gradient Beacon whenever Mitya consumes a Gradient Beacon with the Detection Core.
description.3: Additionally, Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members is Elevated by 20%.
